book.name: 2Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Phawuloosi Ba Ooso Gishshas Immida Qofa
Tani Phawuloosi inttenara dashe ashke geetettadis shin ta inttefe shaakettishin qasse intte bolla xalidaade geetettida tani Phawuloosi Kirstoosa ashketeththaninne iza lo7eteththan inttena woossays.

Tani inttena woossizay ta intteko hee biza wode intte tana xalateththan haasayssontta aggana malassa. Nuni asho qofan simerettiza mala nuna xeelliza issi issi asata sinththan tani xalateththan haasayanaas koyays.
Nuni dizay hayssa alameza bolla gidikkoka nu olettizay ha alameza asa ola mala gidenna.
Nu ola miishshayka ola miixa laallanaas dandayza Xoossa wolqqay dizayssa attiin hayssa alameza ola toora gidenna.
Xoos erontta mala dhuphe gidi dendiza palamanne otoreteth nu laalloos; asa qofa ubbaa di7i ekkidi Kirstoosas azazettana mala ooththoos.
Intte azazeteththi polettiza wode azazettontta ay miishsheka qaxxayanaas nuni giigetti uttidos.
Intte xeellizay kare baggara beettizaaz xalla; oonikka tani Kirstoosasko gi ammanettiko zaareththi qoppo; nunikka iza malakka Kirstoosayta gididayssa izaadey wozinan woththo.
Goday nuus immida maataa gishshas tani izan ceeqqikokka yeellatikke; hessi maatay taas imettiday nuni inttena minththanaas attiin laallanaas gidenna.
Tani ha kiitaan inttena babisos ooththizaa misatoppo.
Oonee erizay issi issi asati, «Phawuloosa kiitati deexonne wolqqama; gido attiin nu achchan diza wode izi laafa; iza haasayaykka leqettidayssako!» gizaaz gidana.
Hessaththo giza asati nuni haahon dishe xaafi kiittidayssassinne qasse inttenara dishe nu ooththizayssa giddon aykko dummateththi bayndayssa shaakki eretto.

Gidikkoka barkka bana nashshiza issi issi asatara nuna nurkka gaththi xeellanaas woykko isttara nuna giigsanaas xalokko; istti qasse barkka bana banara gaththi xeelliza gishshas istti yuushshi qoppizayta gidettenna.
Nu qasse intteko gakkanaas Xoossi nuus immida ooso zawan simerettoos attiin wogappe aaththi ceeqettizayta gidokko.
Intte qasse nu ooththizason diza gishshas Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho qaalaa tamaarsanaas nu intteko bida wode nuni nu zawappe aadhdhibeekko.

Hessa gishshas Xoossi nuus immida zawappe aadhdhidi hara asata ooson gelidi wogappe aadhdhi ceeqettoko; hessafe bollara intte ammanoy diccana malanne nu oosoykka Xoossi nuus immida zawan intte giddon aakkanayssa naagon doos.
Hessa gishshas nu hara asi ooththiza zawa aadhdhidi kasetidi oosettida ooson ceeqettontta dishe inttefe henin diza deretas Mishiraachcho qaalaa yootanaas dandayoos.
Gido attiin Xoossa Maxaafay, «Ceeqettiza asi Godaan ceeqetto» gides.
Asi galatettanaas dandayzay Goday galatikko attiin barkka bana galatiin gidenna.
